title: Egg Prison Awakening
description: A pale woman with long dark hair emerges from a large cracked metallic egg, one half of the shell held open. She wears a flowing purple dress stained with blood that pools on the cracked marble altar beneath her.
prompt: A ghostly pale woman with long black hair and a horrified expression emerges from a giant corroded metal egg covered in dripping slime and rust. The egg is cracked open, one half held by a rusty mechanical arm. She wears a long flowing purple dress soaked in blood at the hem, which pools into an intricate red ritual circle on a cracked white marble altar. Dark gothic cathedral interior with stone pillars and arches in the background, single candle burning on a stand, dramatic cinematic lighting, dark surreal horror atmosphere.
